sourceRegistry.scope: Original MIT NetAtlas QX implementation bundles the ISC-licensed yaml 2.9.1 browser dependency. Loon remains an external AGPL release recipe; no KOP-XIAO parser source is copied.
sourceRegistry.verification: QX conversion and helper tests execute the generated browser bundle in a restricted VM. Loon retains verified upstream GET bytes and non-executing syntax review. Native application imports are not run.

quantumultX.author: NetAtlas contributors

sourceContract.input: QX $resource object with content and optional link/type; unknown type values are not guessed from numbers.
sourceContract.completion: Exactly one $done({content}) or $done({error}); no retry/download request.

quantumultX.behavior: Atomic offline conversion of supported node subscriptions, rule resources and rewrite resources to native QX text. SIP008 v1 server id is validated update metadata only within its servers envelope; unknown connection fields remain errors. Literal name filtering/renaming and official parser-helper UI are implemented. Referenced external HTTPS scripts are emitted only, never executed or fetched by the parser.
quantumultX.limitations: Unsupported protocols, transports, fields, unregistered domain regex, conjunctive headless conditions, ambiguous domain formats, local scripts and certificate settings fail the complete resource. Explicit allow-resolve changes DNS semantics; script-compat=qx declares user-verified API compatibility and does not translate JavaScript. Native QX import/device execution not run.
quantumultX.verification: Executed conversion/helper/VM tests and static browser bundle checks; not native device execution.

loon.author: Peng-YM and Sub-Store contributors

sourceContract.input: Loon $resource string, $resourceType number, $resourceUrl string, $loon and optional $argument.
sourceContract.otherTypes: Passed through; not a general plugin/script rewrite converter.

permissions.network: Product can download $resourceUrl if supplied content cannot be converted; shared download utilities may use subscription caches.
permissions.storage: External bundle runs with Loon host privileges and shared download/cache helpers; no wrapper storage or credential setup.

loon.behavior: Parses node and rule resources into Loon format; enable parser-enabled=true on the chosen existing subscription when conversion is needed.
loon.limitations: The recipe references the official AGPL release bundle without redistributing it. No automatic synchronization or Gist upload hook is installed. The upstream build is not claimed to be reproducible.

unsupportedReason: This feature only supplies the documented QX/Loon resource-parser settings. Other clients may use separate Sub-Store or ScriptHub tools; no equivalent parser-key compatibility is claimed.
